source.title: MunTTS: A Text-to-Speech System for Mundari

verified_locators.supported_proposition: The paper states that its study uses Mundari spoken in Jharkhand and written in Devanagari; it reports 15,656 unique sentences, 26,868 recordings, 27.51 hours, average recording duration 3.7 seconds and average sentence length 8.4 words.

The paper reports beginning from a Hindi corpus, randomly selecting 20,000 sentences for manual translation to Mundari, expressing translated sentences in Devanagari, validating appropriateness with native speakers, and selecting one male and one female recording speaker after screening a pool of 12 speakers.

verified_locators.locator: printed p. 78, continuation of section 3 and Table 1
verified_locators.supported_proposition: The paper reports studio-quality recording through the Karya crowdsourcing application at 44.1 kHz/32 bits per sample, 15,656 unique curated sentences, 26,868 final sentence-recording pairs, approximately 74% female and 26% male recordings, and train/dev/test dataset metrics in Table 1.
The paper reports a 100-point MOS evaluation subset, native-speaker human evaluation on Karya, five annotators per sample, and independent rating of seven variants for each text sample.
